# New Life Assembly of God

> A welcoming Assemblies of God church in Leitchfield, Kentucky, led by Pastor Tony Redmon since 1998. Everyone is welcome; come as you are.

- Address: 47 Embry Acres Dr, Leitchfield, KY 42754
- Pastor Tony Redmon: (270) 200-3422
- Church office: (270) 868-0369
- Facebook: [New Life Assembly of God on Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/newlifeagleitchfield)

## Service times

- Sunday School: Sundays at 10:00 AM
- Sunday Morning Service: Sundays at 11:00 AM (praise and worship, then preaching at 11:30 AM)
- Children's Church: Sundays at 11:30 AM
- Wednesday Bible Study: Wednesdays at 6:30 PM

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.newlifeaogleitchfield.com/): service times, upcoming events, and an overview of church life
- [About](https://www.newlifeaogleitchfield.com/about): the church's story and Pastor Tony Redmon
- [What We Believe](https://www.newlifeaogleitchfield.com/beliefs): core beliefs of the Assemblies of God
- [Leadership](https://www.newlifeaogleitchfield.com/leadership): Pastor Tony, the church board, ministry leaders, and the worship team
- [Ministries](https://www.newlifeaogleitchfield.com/ministries): Sunday School, Sunday worship, Children's Church, Bible study, women's ministries, and outreach
- [Watch](https://www.newlifeaogleitchfield.com/watch): recorded sermons and Sunday worship
- [Prayer Requests](https://www.newlifeaogleitchfield.com/prayer): send a prayer request to Pastor Tony, privately if you prefer
- [Plan Your Visit](https://www.newlifeaogleitchfield.com/contact): directions, what to expect, FAQs, and a contact form
